name: app-white-project-introduction-text-with-metadata-rows
title: White Project Introduction with Metadata Rows
whatItIs: A white slide with a small 'Introduction' label at left and a large paragraph on the right whose middle phrases fade to grey, followed by ruled rows for Year, Industry and Scope of work, and a small app icon and name.
whatItMeans: The grey phrases and hairline rows give a calm editorial rhythm, and the strong asymmetry keeps a text slide interesting.
techniques: Asymmetric layout with the label far left and text on the right
Mid-paragraph shift from black to grey to emphasise
Tiny logo lockup as the sign-off

vocabulary.definition: Changing text between dark and light greys to guide reading.
A row separated by hairlines showing one label and value.
A slash-separated list of the services provided.
